title: Reading concerts
intro1: **Literature meets music:** At our reading concerts, words and sound come together to create a special experience for the mind and soul. These concerts have been organised in collaboration with the Frankfurt bookshop *Ulrich von Hutten*.
intro2: They are hugely popular and have become something of an insider’s tip since 2024. Over a glass of wine, a very special atmosphere takes hold on the upper floor of the bookshop – cosy, intimate and unforgettable.
format1: Musicians from the Brandenburg State Orchestra Frankfurt (Oder) perform a selection of chamber music, whilst literary texts – prose, poetry or essays – accompany the evening. The two art forms engage in a genuine dialogue: sometimes contrasting, sometimes complementing one another, but always enriching.
format2: Every event is unique – the programmes and texts are put together specifically for each evening. This creates a new, one-of-a-kind experience every time, in familiar surroundings.
infobox: **Free admission – donations welcome:** The reading concerts are free to attend. Donations are welcome and will go directly towards ensuring this series continues.
mitmachen: As a member of Förderverein, you’ll be personally invited to every reading concert and will be the first to hear about new dates. Please support this special event, which brings literature and music together at Frankfurt (Oder).
